d:
chhath mahaparv ke avsar par sabhi bhakton ko hardik shubhkamnaen. chhathi maiya aur sury dev ki kripa sabhi par bani rahe. sabhi ke jivan men sukh, shanti aur samriddhi aae.
jay chhathi maiya! sharda sinha ji ke chhath puja giton ka yah Jukebox bahut khas hai. unke paranprik bhojpuri chhath giton ki apni alag pahchan hai.
Chhath mahaparv ke pavan avsar par prastut hai bihar ki svar kokila sharda sinha ji ke madhur aur paranprik bhojpuri chhath puja giton ka vishesh sangraha.
